senses.gloss: अ-व्रण॑ mf(आ)n. unhurt, unscarred, sound, VS. xl, 8; BhP.
(generally said of bows, swords, sticks &c.) without rents or splinters or notches, entire, KātyŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
अ-व्रत॑ mf(आ)n. lawless, disobedient, wicked, RV.; AV.; SV.
not observing religious rites or obligations, Gobh.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
अ-व्रत—वत् mfn. not observing religious rites, MBh. xii, 2305.
अ-व्रतिक mfn. = अव्रत-वत्, q.v., MBh. xii, 1336.
अ-व्रतिन् mfn. id., MBh. xiii, 1601; R.
अ-व्रत्य॑ अम्, n. anything out of harmony with, or violating, a religious obligation, ŚBr.; AitBr.; AitĀr.
अ-व्रत्य॑ mfn. with कर्मन् id., Gobh.
अ॑-व्रात्य m. not a Vratya, AV. xv, 13, 6
अ॑-व्रात्य n. = अ-व्रत्य॑ n. q.v., Viṣṇus.
अव्रत्योपचार m. practising anything that offends one's religious obligations, ĀśvŚr.; ĀśvGṛ.
अ-व्राजिन् mfn. ‘not wandering’, (g. ग्राह्य्-आदि, q.v.)

आ-√ व्रज् P. -व्रजति, to come near, proceed to, ŚBr.; Lāṭy.; Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.;
to come back or home, return, R.; BhP.; Suśr.; MBh. &c.
आ-व्रजित mfn. come near, come home.

आ-√ व्रश्च् P. -वृश्चति, to tear off, cut off;
to separate, remove, ŚBr.; Kāṭh.; TBr. : Ā. -वृश्चते, AV. xii, 4, 6, &c. (aor. 1. sg. -वृक्षि, RV. i, 27, 13; TS.; ŚāṅkhŚr.)
to cut off, take away:
Pass. -वृश्च्यते, to be torn or cut off, RV.; AV.; TBr.
आ-व्र॑श्चन n. the stump of a tree, TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Nyāyam.
आ-व्रस्क m. (cf. अन्˚), the being torn off or dropping down.
a fissure, place of cutting &c., Kauś.
आव्रीडक mfn. (fr. अ-व्रीड, g. राजन्यादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 53), inhabited by shameless people.
